text: Implemented the universal unsymmetrized ordered outer-product feature primitive and streamed rectangular/packed contraction. Direct pair queries now evaluate b_left^T H b_right inside feature tasks; legacy cross-Gram streaming routes through explicit self-adjoint half edges. Independent rectangular oracle, transpose, block-splitting, query pushdown, single-read, block-store, dense/sparse self differential, block-size, partition-order, fail-before-read, and conservative memory-plan tests pass. Full testthat suite: 903 assertions. Final source tarball built with vignettes; R CMD check --as-cran exited 0 with 2 non-code NOTEs only (new submission/version and local outdated HTML Tidy). git diff --check clean.
